description: Brescia Mobilità Spa publishes an inventory of parking facilities and on-street parking in the municipality of Brescia. Its native catalogue groups two CSV distributions: structured parking facilities and parking meters associated with on-street spaces. They are retained as one parking resource. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with annual updating declared and a catalogue revision dated 28 November 2024. That revision is not a verified asset observation date. The inventory can provide parking-system asset inputs for transport capacity-planning studies. No CSV rows were opened, so space counts, tariffs, operating hours, coordinates and current occupancy are not established. The related Brescia local-public-transport record concerns bus stops; it does not represent these parking assets. Source metadata and the repository landing route were checked, but the distribution contents and present operating status remain unverified.
